    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersVenice cod, prosciutto and sardine toastsBaguette toasts with smoked cod, prosciutto and fig, or sardines and raisinsHow to make it200g smoked cod250ml milk, for poaching1 potato, boiled2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil1 baguette1 tbsp chopped parsley60g prosciutto2 figs, sliced1 tin sardines1/2 onion, thinly sliced30g raisinsBoil the potato until soft. Poach the cod in milk for 8 minutes, then flake.Beat the flaked cod with the potato and olive oil into a rough spread.Toast the baguette slices.Top a third with the cod spread and parsley, a third with prosciutto and fig, and the rest with sardines, onion and raisins.Austrian castle pretzelsHomemade soft pretzels with a camembert paprika butter dipHow to make it400g plain flour7g dried yeast250ml warm water2 tbsp bicarb soda1 tbsp rock salt200g ripe camembert50g butter, softened1 tsp sweet paprika1 tbsp finely chopped onionMix the flour, yeast and water into a dough and knead until smooth.Prove until doubled in size.Shape into pretzels and dip briefly in bicarb water. Sprinkle with salt.Bake at 220°C for 12 minutes.Mash the camembert with the butter, paprika and onion for obatzda.Circus train peanut caramel popcorn ballsYoung Indy running through the circus trainHow to make itAs written, serves 4Popcorn and salted roasted peanuts bound in a golden syrup caramel, pressed into fist-sized balls and wrapped in paper like a circus stall treat.Pop 100g popcorn kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot and tip into a large bowl with 150g roasted salted peanuts.Boil 200g caster sugar, 80g golden syrup, 60g butter and 3 tbsp water to 125°C, then stir in half a teaspoon of bicarb and 1 tsp salt.Pour over the popcorn and toss with an oiled spoon.Shape into 12 balls with buttered hands, cool for 20 minutes and wrap each in baking paper.MainsZeppelin dining room schnitzelCrisp pork schnitzel with warm potato saladHow to make it4 pork schnitzels100g plain flour2 eggs, beaten150g panko breadcrumbs50g butter3 tbsp vegetable oil800g potatoes, boiled2 tbsp white wine vinegar1 onion, finely diced1 Lebanese cucumber, sliced1 lemon, cut into wedgesBoil the potatoes until tender, slice and toss while warm with vinegar, oil and onion.Pound the schnitzels thin. Crumb in flour, egg and panko.Fry in butter and oil until golden and puffy.Serve with the potato salad, sliced cucumber and lemon.Hatay lamb kebabs with garlic yoghurtThe desert road to the canyonHow to make itAs written, serves 4Lamb mince with onion, garlic, sumac, chilli and parsley pressed onto skewers and grilled hot, with warm flatbread, charred tomatoes and garlic yoghurt.Grate 1 onion and squeeze out the juice.Knead 800g lamb mince with the onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp sumac, 1 tsp chilli flakes, a handful of chopped parsley and 1.5 tsp salt for 2 minutes.Press around 8 flat skewers and chill for 30 minutes.Grill on a very hot barbecue for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, with 4 halved tomatoes.Stir 1 grated garlic clove and a pinch of salt into 250g Greek yoghurt.Serve on warm flatbread with the tomatoes and yoghurt.SweetsPetra rose and pistachio cakeAlmond and pistachio cake soaked in lemon rosewater syrupHow to make it4 eggs300g caster sugar200g almond meal130g pistachios, 100g ground and the rest crushed1 lemon, juiced2 tsp rosewater1 tbsp edible rose petalsWhisk the eggs with most of the sugar, then fold in the almond meal and ground pistachios.Bake in a lined tin at 170°C for 40 minutes.Simmer the remaining sugar with the lemon juice and a splash of water, add the rosewater and pour over the cake.Top with crushed pistachios and rose petals.DrinksChosen wisely pomegranate red wine cupRed wine, pomegranate juice, orange and brandy over ice, juice version for driversHow to make it400ml pomegranate juice60g caster sugar1 cinnamon stick3 whole cloves750ml tempranillo or shiraz1 orange, sliced60ml brandy1 pomegranate, seeds only2 cups iceWarm half the pomegranate juice with the sugar, cinnamon and cloves until the sugar dissolves, then cool.Pour into a jug with the tempranillo or shiraz, the rest of the juice, orange slices and brandy.Chill for at least 2 hours.Pour over ice into cups and scatter pomegranate seeds on top.
